digest.component_or_area: live jira dc harness / provenance oracle test
propositions: the provenance test asserts the raw jira key against a lowercased local id via case-sensitive substring scan, making the assertion unable to pass
the ticket payload carries no raw jira key field, only the lowercased local id and an optional title fallback, so the remote key binding is not discoverable via list_tickets
the test must assert the local ticket id exactly equals the result of _jira_key_to_local_id(remote_key) rather than scanning json.dumps for a substring
the test must additionally assert the binding store maps the local id to the remote_key to prove the round-trip correspondence
a unit test must pin _jira_key_to_local_id lowercasing and prefixing behavior independently so the live oracle's derivation is verifiable without the full harness
